meta.bin: mask[k] is the horizon elevation at azimuth k*360/nb deg (clockwise from north), linear in between
meta.dist_unit: 10 m, uint16 LE (for the first observer height)
meta.method: rays 0-55 km (bilinear, finest DEM) + 3D scatter of 20 m pixels 4-50 km and 240 m pixels 45-400 km
meta.slope: gradient of the cubic B-spline approximant; 10 m central baseline on the 5 m grid, 40 m on the 20 m grid

grid.coding: gzip of: per mask int16 LE first value, then int8 deltas (escape -128 + int16 LE absolute)
